title: The WPvivid — Backup, Migration & Staging plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Arbitrary File… (CVE-2026-84693)
description: The WPvivid Backup, Migration & Staging plugin for WordPress versions up to and including 0.9.134 contains an arbitrary file deletion vulnerability. This arises from a timing side channel in RSA decryption, insufficient validation of migration receiver backup records, and missing path validation in the cleanup_local_backup() function. An unauthenticated attacker with access to an unexpired receiver key can inject a backup record with path traversal, causing scheduled cleanup to delete arbitrary files writable by the web server.
